description: McKenzie Highway Opening and Closing Dates is a dataset listed in State of Oregon open data portal (data.oregon.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Oregon. Historic Opening and Closing Dates of McKenzie Highway (OR242) since 1925. Coverage: Oregon. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are or242, mckenzie highway. The table has 5 columns. The portal shows 2017-05-25 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-oregon-gov-portal.
